attchmntText: J.Kumar Infraprojects Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: J. Kumar Infraprojects Limited filed an investor presentation for the un-audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the second quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 15% year-on-year to 1,539 crore rupees in the quarter and by 8% to 3,050 crore rupees in the half year. EBITDA rose by 18% to 229 crore rupees in the quarter and by 8% to 443 crore rupees in the half year. Profit after tax grew by 25% to 113 crore rupees in the quarter and by 9% to 211 crore rupees in the half year. The order book stood at 22,711 crore rupees as of 30th September, 2026.

attchmntText: press release for the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results
voiceSummary: J. Kumar Infraprojects Limited filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations regarding its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated Revenue from Operations for Q2 FY27 increased by 15% to Rs. 1,539 crores. EBITDA rose by 18% to Rs. 229 crores with a margin of 14.9%. Profit After Tax improved by 25% to Rs. 113 crores. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, Revenue from Operations grew by 8% to Rs. 3,050 crores. PAT increased by 9% to Rs. 211 crores. Net Debt as on 30th September 2026 stood at negative Rs. 69 crores. The total Order Book as on 30th September 2026 was Rs. 22,711 crores.

attchmntText: J.Kumar Infraprojects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Reappointment of Mr. Sidharath Kapur as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. February 08, 2027.
voiceSummary: J. Kumar Infraprojects Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations was 1,535.50 Crore. Profit after tax was 113.77 Crore. Earnings per share was 15.04. The Board approved the re-appointment of Mr. Sidharath Kapur, DIN 02153416, as Non-Executive Independent Director for a second term of five years, from 8th February 2027 to 7th February 2032. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval. The trading window for dealing in company securities by Designated Persons re-opens from 16th November 2026.
